newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telecoms strong in NY ADR market.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telecoms strong in NY ADR market.

text.p: Latin American and European telecommunication stocks showed strength in New York on Tuesday in the wake of British Telecommunications Plc's multibillion-dollar bid for MCI Communications Corp, traders said.

"The whole telecoms sector is in a little bit of a craze now with the BT deal," said Rick Curi, a foreign equities trader at Schroder Wertheim & Co. "For the next six months this is going to be a focus for a lot of people."
Among rising American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in New York, Telefonica de Espana S.A. was up 1-1/2 to 61. France's Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite' rose 1/4 to 17-1/8.
Telefonica's rise also followed news it would pull out of a cable television venture with pay TV giant Sogecable, a unit of Promotora de Informaciones S.A. and France's Cable Plus.

Among Latin American telecommunications stocks, Brazil's Telebras was up 1-7/8 to 78-3/4 ahead of nine-month earnings, expected out later on Tuesday, and the publication of terms for cellular concessions.
Telefonica de Argentina rose 1/4 to 24-1/4 and Telecom Argentina was up 1/2 to 39-1/8.
British Telecom itself was off 3/4 to 60-7/8 after its shares soared on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday.
Among other stocks, the Netherlands' KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV was up one to 25-3/8 after management unveiled a cost-cutting program.
British Airways was up 2-1/8 to 92-5/8 after a rise in six-month profits.
